positive.prompt: Convene a council of different models to compare these database designs.
I want independent second opinions and a synthesized recommendation on this tradeoff.
Have a red-team and an implementation-minded agent evaluate the same rollout decision.

negative.prompt: The council proposals disagree; circulate them for a second round of critique.
Research where this API is used across the repository and summarize the evidence.

evals.prompt: Use a council to decide whether this service should use SQLite or Postgres. Show me the proposed council before you launch anything.
evals.expected_output: A shared decision question, decision criteria, and model-diverse member roster are proposed without launching any member before approval
expectations: The response frames one shared decision question and concrete comparison criteria
The proposed members prioritize model diversity and have complementary perspectives
Every proposed member would receive the same question and criteria
No subagent or external model is launched before the user approves the roster
